name: Add Github Plugin
description:
Add a github plugin. This plugin will link a github PR to a story

- Stories will contain a "Github PR" field when plugin is enabled.
- Update rowbly factory and dev skills so they update this wheneer a PR for a story is opened.
- Use the `gh` cli to periodically fetch the status of a PR.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Plan revision required before acceptance. github id and GitHub PR field accepted; Story-screen in-memory periodic gh refresh plus explicit status is enough; no saved polling data and no timers in hooks/CLI. Defer Board-card badge/cache fan-out unless needed for criteria. Avoid redundant link/unlink commands if stories create/edit flags already meet linking. Reserve ADR0051 only after revised API plan; 0050 is ROW65. Scope process capability to demonstrated read-only gh PR inspection; propose a narrow host-owned API or a constrained declared invocation rather than unrestricted executable/argv feature. Keep core free of Plugin terms and document this is trusted in-process capability, not permission/sandbox. Require argv arrays/no shell, bounded stdout/stderr/timeouts/concurrency/cancellation and no effect from read/operation hooks; all timers disposed on unmount/disable/root switch. Add/update REQUIRED tests in existing homes: runtime capability boundary outside/inside hooks, storage-format compatibility per new Built-in Plugin checklist, existing operation inventory/docs fixtures/language. No tests planned is not sufficient for new Plugin loading/API pipeline/storage contract. URL parsing must reject credentials/invalid path and preserve opaque/future data. Keep short distinct skill additions; merge main before final checks. Do not edit .rowbly and await accepted revised plan before implementation.
